features: fair skin, close-cropped light hair, light eyes, broad open face, heavy jaw, solid stocky build, wry half-smile, leather helmet with goggles pushed up
bio: Left Lanús for Europe in 1932 with a secondhand Bugatti and a letter of introduction that nobody had asked for. Made his name on the road circuits — Avus, Pescara, the Nürburgring in the wet — where a driver with no money could still embarrass one with a factory contract. Auto Union gave him a Type D for the 3-litre formula. Runs the car harder than it wants to be run and grins about it afterwards.
